title: target-dir Linux wiring for rust workspace (env script or config comment)
description: Child of xyt6 (2/2): papercut half. rust/.cargo/config.toml pins target-dir=/Volumes/Attic/Cache/Cargo (Mac root-drive protection); Linux workers must export CARGO_TARGET_DIR (e.g. ~/.cache/lichen-cargo-target) or cargo build steps fail with EACCES. Ship a tiny scripts/rust-env.sh (or equivalent doc) exporting CARGO_TARGET_DIR on non-macOS hosts, and keep the config comment pointing to it. Do NOT remove the Mac redirect (root-drive protection is deliberate on macOS).
